home_title.so: Mareeg qaran oo adeegga muwaadinka u hormarinaysa
home_title.sw: Tovuti ya kitaifa ya EAC inayotanguliza huduma

home_intro.en: Designed around the questions citizens, traders, students and public institutions actually need answered — not only institutional history.
home_intro.so: Loogu talagalay su'aalaha muwaadiniinta, ganacsatada, ardayda iyo hay'adaha dawladda dhab ahaantii u baahan yihiin — ma aha taariikh hay'adeed oo keliya.
home_intro.sw: Imeundwa kuzunguka maswali wanayohitaji wananchi, wafanyabiashara, wanafunzi na taasisi za umma — si historia ya taasisi pekee.

tracker_intro.en: Sample progress visualization. In Phase 2 every record becomes structured, filterable and backed by named government focal points.
tracker_intro.so: Muujinta horumarka tijaabada. Wajiga 2aad diiwaan kasta wuxuu noqonayaa mid qaabaysan, la kala saari karo oo ay taageerayaan xafiisyo dawladeed oo magac leh.
tracker_intro.sw: Onyesho la mfano la maendeleo. Awamu ya 2 kila rekodi itakuwa na muundo, kuchujwa, na vituo vya mawasiliano vya serikali vilivyo na majina.

tracker_answers.en: What has Somalia committed to? Which institution owns it? What is the deadline? What is the current verified status?
tracker_answers.so: Maxay Soomaaliya ballanqaaday? Hay'adkee ayaa mas'uul ka ah? Waa maxay kama dambaysta? Waa maxay xaaladda la xaqiijiyay?
tracker_answers.sw: Somalia imejitolea nini? Taasisi ipi inamiliki? Tarehe ya mwisho ni ipi? Hali iliyothibitishwa sasa ni ipi?

tracker_filters.en: Pillar · Ministry · Deadline · Status · Legal source · Last verified date.
tracker_filters.so: Tiirka · Wasaaradda · Kama dambaysta · Xaaladda · Xogta sharciga · Taariikhda la xaqiijiyay.
tracker_filters.sw: Nguzo · Wizara · Tarehe ya mwisho · Hali · Chanzo cha kisheria · Tarehe ya uthibitisho.

news_title.sw: Masuala ya hivi karibuni ya EAC

news_intro.en: Structured categories keep EAC integration, trade, mobility and opportunities easy to find.
news_intro.so: Qaybaha qaabaysan waxay fududeeyaan helitaanka isku-dhafka EAC, ganacsiga, dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo fursadaha.
news_intro.sw: Makundi yaliyopangwa yanarahisisha kupata ujumuishaji wa EAC, biashara, uhamaji na fursa.

opp_intro.en: Jobs, scholarships, tenders, consultancies and training opportunities relevant to Somali nationals and institutions.
opp_intro.so: Shaqooyin, deeqo waxbarasho, qandaraasyo, la-talin iyo tababar ku habboon muwaadiniinta iyo hay'adaha Soomaaliyeed.
opp_intro.sw: Kazi, udhamini, zabuni, ushauri na fursa za mafunzo zinazowahusu raia na taasisi za Somalia.

docs_intro.en: Designed for metadata, filtering, stable URLs and plain-language summaries in the database-backed phase.
docs_intro.so: Loogu talagalay xog-dheer, shaandhayn, URL-yo joogto ah iyo soo-koobid luuqad fudud marka xog-ururinta la dhisayo.
docs_intro.sw: Imeandaliwa kwa metadata, kuchuja, anwani thabiti na muhtasari wa lugha rahisi katika awamu ya hifadhidata.

minister_eyebrow.sw: Waziri msimamizi wa Masuala ya EAC

official_profile.sw: Wasifu rasmi wa Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ↗

image_notice.en: Official MFA portrait of the State Minister in charge of EAC Affairs.
image_notice.so: Sawirka rasmiga ah ee MFA ee Wasiirka Gobolka ee Arrimaha EAC.
image_notice.sw: Picha rasmi ya Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje ya Waziri wa Nchi msimamizi wa Masuala ya EAC.

form_success.en: Thank you. This QA form stored a sample submission for design testing. It is not an official government channel.
form_success.so: Mahadsanid. Foomkan QA wuxuu kaydiyay soo-gudbin tijaabo ah. Ma aha kanaal dawladeed oo rasmi ah.
form_success.sw: Asante. Fomu hii ya QA imehifadhi wasilisho la mfano kwa jaribio la muundo. Sio kituo rasmi cha serikali.

form_error.so: Fadlan buuxi meelaha loo baahan yahay.

form_qa_notice.en: This is a QA prototype form. Submissions are stored locally for design review and are not routed to a ministry inbox.
form_qa_notice.so: Kani waa foom tijaabo QA ah. Soo-gudbinta waxaa lagu kaydiyaa maxalli si loo eego naqshadda, lagumana diro sanduuqa wasaaradda.
form_qa_notice.sw: Hii ni fomu ya mfano wa QA. Wasilisho zinahifadhiwa hapa kwa ukaguzi wa muundo na hazitumwi kwenye sanduku la wizara.

page_not_found_text.en: The page you requested is not part of this QA prototype, or the address is incorrect.
page_not_found_text.so: Bogga aad waydiisatay kama mid aha tijaabadan QA, ama cinwaanku waa khalad.
page_not_found_text.sw: Ukurasa uliouomba si sehemu ya mfumo huu wa QA, au anwani si sahihi.

need_next_text.en: This national gateway is built around the next action — trade, mobility, documents or the public tracker.
need_next_text.so: Albaabkan qaran wuxuu ku dhisan yahay tallaabada xigta — ganacsi, dhaqdhaqaaq, dukumentiyo ama raadinta dadweynaha.
need_next_text.sw: Lango hili la taifa limejengwa kuzunguka hatua inayofuata — biashara, uhamaji, nyaraka au kifuatiliaji cha umma.

step_three.en: 3. Production will route to the ministry
step_three.so: 3. Soo-saaristu waxay u diri doontaa wasaaradda

form_intro.en: Use this form for prototype testing. Required fields are marked.
form_intro.so: Isticmaal foomkan tijaabada. Meelaha loo baahan yahay waa la calaamadeeyay.
form_intro.sw: Tumia fomu hii kwa jaribio la mfano. Sehemu zinazohitajika zimewekwa alama.

brand_ministry.sw: Wizara ya Mambo ya Nje na Ushirikiano wa Kimataifa

hero_home_title.en: Somalia in the East African Community
hero_home_title.sw: Somalia katika Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki

hero_home_text.en: Building peace, prosperity and a shared future through regional integration, free movement and sustainable economic growth.
hero_home_text.so: Dhisidda nabad, barwaaqo iyo mustaqbal wadaag ah iyadoo loo marayo isku-dhafka gobolka, dhaqdhaqaaqa xorta ah iyo koboca dhaqaale ee waara.
hero_home_text.sw: Kujenga amani, ustawi na mustakabali wa pamoja kupitia ujumuishaji wa kikanda, uhuru wa kutembea na ukuaji endelevu wa uchumi.

eighth_member_title.en: Somalia is the 8th Member State of the EAC
eighth_member_title.sw: Somalia ni Nchi Mshirika ya 8 ya EAC

eighth_member_text.en: On 4 March 2024 Somalia acceded as a full Partner State — opening a new chapter of regional trade, mobility and political cooperation.
eighth_member_text.so: 4-tii Maarso 2024 Soomaaliya waxay noqotay xubin buuxda — cutub cusub oo ganacsi goboleed, dhaqdhaqaaq iyo iskaashi siyaasadeed.
eighth_member_text.sw: Tarehe 4 Machi 2024 Somalia ilijiunga kama Nchi Mshirika kamili — ukurasa mpya wa biashara ya kikanda, uhamaji na ushirikiano wa kisiasa.

trade_banner_text.en: Access markets of over 300 million people through the EAC's integrated economy.
trade_banner_text.so: Geli suuqyo ka badan 300 milyan oo qof iyadoo loo marayo dhaqaalaha isku dhafan ee EAC.
trade_banner_text.sw: Fikia masoko ya zaidi ya watu milioni 300 kupitia uchumi uliounganishwa wa EAC.

footer_portal_blurb.en: The official portal of the Federal Republic of Somalia for East African Community affairs — trade, mobility, integration and citizen services.
footer_portal_blurb.so: Albaabka rasmiga ah ee Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya ee arrimaha Bulshada Bariga Afrika — ganacsi, dhaqdhaqaaq, isku-dhaf iyo adeegyada muwaadiniinta.
footer_portal_blurb.sw: Lango rasmi la Jamhuri ya Shirikisho la Somalia kwa masuala ya Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki — biashara, uhamaji, ujumuishaji na huduma kwa wananchi.
